reviewFindingsAddressed.problem: marginInlineStart sat on the RIGHT of each word in the RTL flex row, so the gap landed before each word and the last word got 0 — the final word pair fused on screen («خریددوباره» at f150, «روزهای‌کاری» at f95), reading as a shaping/word-order defect.
reviewFindingsAddressed.fix: Moved the margin to the trailing side: marginInlineEnd on every word except the last (the trailing-side mirror of the source's marginRight-on-all-but-last). Word gaps now match the original's spacing rhythm exactly.

reviewFindingsAddressed.problem: Column slots and the top title bars were mirrored, but the header and row bars inside each column were still left-anchored at the column's left edge — mixed alignment, whereas the source has every bar left-aligned.
reviewFindingsAddressed.fix: DOC_COLS now stores the column's right-edge inset (r = 14 + c*(COL_W+10), the exact mirror of the source's left inset) and every header/row bar is anchored with right: r, so bars sit flush at each column's reading edge. Bar widths and the rand(c*13+r*7) seeds are unchanged.

reviewFindingsAddressed.problem: The caption's right edge was flush with the pill's outer right edge, losing the source's 4px inset from the pill's start edge.
reviewFindingsAddressed.fix: right = 440 - PX - 172 + 4 = 218, so the caption's right edge is inset 4px inside the pill's start (right) edge — the exact mirror of the source's left = PX + 4.

reviewFindingsAddressed.problem: The comment claimed the skeleton columns mirror as a whole and said nothing about the caption word-gap handling; the report claimed all frames clean despite the visibly fused words.
reviewFindingsAddressed.fix: The header comment now documents the word-gap rule and the per-column bar mirroring; this report was rewritten with the verified fix evidence.

rtlDecisions.what: Parked document position and park motion
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored to the right side; changed the anchor to the right edge and the park translation to +55%.
rtlDecisions.why: The source document sits on the left and slides left as reading-direction layout. Persian reading begins at the right, so its retained source panel belongs there and must travel outward to the right.

rtlDecisions.what: Skeleton document columns and every bar inside them
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the three column slots (first column right-most, inset r = 14 + c*(COL_W+10) from the right edge) AND right-anchored the header and row bars at each column's right edge (right: r); the two dark title bars at the document top stay right-anchored. Widths and seeded values unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: They represent document reading layout; in the source everything is left-aligned to the LTR reading edge, so the faithful mirror is everything right-aligned to the RTL reading edge — per column, not just per document. Fix round 2 completed this mirroring for the in-column bars.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved the stack from the right to the left side and set each pill row to RTL, placing the icon at the right of its label.
rtlDecisions.why: The cards follow the source's left-to-right reading progression, which becomes right-to-left. Their top-to-bottom order remains because vertical order has no RTL meaning.

rtlDecisions.what: Caption text, word-gap and progressive word emphasis
rtlDecisions.action: Translated the three captions into concise idiomatic Persian; split on word spaces in logical Persian order, laid out RTL, removed tracking (the source's negative letterSpacing has no healthy Persian equivalent). Word spacing uses marginInlineEnd on every word except the last — the trailing-side mirror of the source's marginRight — which fixes the fused final word pair found in review. Kept the original per-word emphasis and fade timing (first word = right-most).
rtlDecisions.why: Persian joins within each word and reads from right to left. The original gap sits AFTER each word in LTR flow; in the RTL flex row the trailing side is the left, so the gap must move to marginInlineEnd or the last word pair fuses.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept y positions, vertical stack order, opacity, outBack translateY/scale, deal starts, scroll amount and timing curves unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are timing/physics and vertical composition semantics rather than reading-direction movement.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept its upward direction, 3-cycle modulo and 40px travel unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The slow scroll communicates a document being read while vertical movement remains physical and universal.

rtlDecisions.action: 172px RTL caption box beneath each pill, right edge inset 4px inside the pill's start (right) edge: right = 440 - PX - 172 + 4 = 218.
rtlDecisions.why: The source caption sits 4px inside the pill's left (start) edge; mirroring that anchor preserves the relationship and clears the parked panel. Fix round 2 restored the inset that was lost.

rasterHandling.assets: None. The document skeleton and icons are live CSS/SVG shapes.
rasterHandling.action: No raster edits or replacement required; the vector skeleton was mirrored with its document layout.

lessons: RTL flex word-gap pitfall: a per-word margin must sit on the TRAILING side (marginInlineEnd) to mirror an LTR marginRight; marginInlineStart in an RTL row puts the gap on the right of each word, which fuses the last word pair and adds a spurious right margin to the first word.

Mirroring an absolutely-positioned multi-column skeleton must be done per column AND per bar: anchoring only the column slots (or only the title bars) leaves the in-column bars left-aligned and produces mixed alignment that reads as a defect.
In RTL, logical mirror insets flip sides: a caption inset 4px from the pill's left edge becomes 4px inside the pill's RIGHT edge, i.e. right = W - PX - width + 4, not W - PX - width - 4.
